name: Anushka Tyagi
headline: Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience across enterprise e-commerce systems, multi-currency payment workflows, and bidirectional data pipelines.
tagline: I build payment, marketplace and POS systems that stay up when real money flows through them.
summary: Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience across enterprise e-commerce systems, multi-currency payment workflows, and bidirectional data pipelines.
Delivered custom modules for 27+ international clients, managing complex API integrations and shipping projects independently from requirements to production under strict deadlines.
Investigated and resolved high-priority production issues through debugging, root-cause analysis, and code-level fixes.
Comfortable adapting to new technologies such as implementing India Post's React-based DigiPIN in PHP-based platforms such as CS-Cart.

highlights.Payment & Transaction: Designed and delivered 5 international payment gateway integrations over REST APIs (including Stripe, Stripe Connect, dLocal Go, CyberSource Secure Acceptance and Mercado Pago), following PCI-DSS principles with client-side iframe tokenization and hosted checkout, implementing marketplace split payments, hold-and-capture, refund, and multi-currency return workflows.
highlights.POS & Retail Systems: Extended a multi-vendor Point-of-Sale (POS) system with outlet/cashier session handling, drawer-based checkout, X/Z reports, QR-scanned invoices, and an RMA flow with multi-currency/multi-language support.
highlights.Marketplace: Developed marketplace workflows, including auctions, multi-day booking/rental, and customer-to-customer (C2C) selling.
highlights.Advanced API Integrations: Integrated third-party APIs for shipping (real-time rates, label generation, pickup scheduling), OTP authentication (Twilio/WhatsApp), and location services (Google address autocomplete, DigiPIN geo-addressing).
highlights.AI/ML Integrations: Integrated and maintained AI/ML APIs for semantic search, automated image background removal, and product category prediction.
highlights.CMS Connectors: Designed and developed OMS-style connectors, unidirectional (GraphQL, Bagisto) and bidirectional (REST, Unopim), syncing products, categories, customers, and orders across e-commerce platforms.
highlights.Performance & Infrastructure: Improved performance and delivery through service workers, caching, prefetching, AMP/PWA techniques, Amazon S3 media storage, and Google Tag Manager behavior tracking.
highlights.Legacy Modernization & Code Health: Refactored and upgraded PHP e-commerce codebases, framework version migrations, deprecation handling, and custom theme/plugin compatibility, validating changes on staging with QA and deploying to production.
highlights.Technical Delivery & Leadership: Owned end-to-end delivery for 27+ international clients, requirement gathering, cross-team coordination with QA and DevOps, and L2/L3 technical support, and mentored 4 junior developers on company workflows in Linux environments.
